components.name: BottomSheet
components.description: Modal bottom sheet. Custom portal, not a native dialog. Mid and full snap.
whenToUse: Sheet from the bottom edge. Mid and full snap. Custom portal, not a native dialog.
whenNotToUse: Use Dialog when the task stays centered. Do not morph a Dialog into a sheet.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Dismiss requests. Staying open keeps the sheet open.

components.name: BottomSheet.Body
components.description: Scroll container. Drag starts only at scrollTop 0.
whenToUse: Scrollable sheet body. Drag starts only at scrollTop 0.

components.name: BottomSheet.Close
components.description: Ghost Button.Root that requests close-button dismiss.
whenToUse: Ghost close control that requests close-button dismiss.

components.name: BottomSheet.Description
components.description: Supporting text. Wires aria-describedby.
whenToUse: Supporting text wired as the sheet description.

components.name: BottomSheet.Footer
components.description: Action row.
whenToUse: Action row at the bottom of the sheet.

components.name: BottomSheet.Grabber
components.description: Drag handle. Rendered by default if omitted. Arrow keys change snap.
whenToUse: Drag handle. Rendered by default if omitted. Arrow keys change snap.

components.name: BottomSheet.Header
components.description: Chrome. Drag-eligible.
whenToUse: Title row for the sheet.

components.name: BottomSheet.Title
components.description: Heading. Wires aria-labelledby.
whenToUse: Visible sheet title. Names the dialog when present.

components.name: Button.Icon
components.description: Order-only decorative icon. Always aria-hidden. No side prop.
whenToUse: Decorative icon inside Button.Root. Position is DOM order. Always aria-hidden.
whenNotToUse: Not a free-floating atom. Do not import a raw Icon instead of Button.Icon.

components.name: Button.Root
components.description: Native button. Owns variant, type, and disabled. Default type is button.
whenToUse: Primary actions. Icon-only roots need aria-label or aria-labelledby. Default type is button.
whenNotToUse: Do not nest Button.Root inside Field.Root as a second role. Fitting labeled buttons do not tip.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required accessible name when the only child is Button.Icon. Auto-tip text for icon-only.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Icon-only tips the accessible name. Overflowing labels tip the full string. False opts out. Never tips a fitting labeled button.

props.name: children
props.description: Label and optional Button.Icon. Order is leading or trailing.

slots.name: children
slots.description: Label text and optional Button.Icon in DOM order.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description: Chrome-only attached row of Button.Root. role=group. No selection state.
whenToUse: Attached row of Button.Root. role=group. Chrome only.
whenNotToUse: No selection state. Use RadioGroup or OptionList to choose.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Native checkbox. Children are the visible label. Never indeterminate.
whenToUse: Several independent choices that stay on the page. Children are the visible label. Never indeterminate.
whenNotToUse: Use Radio when one exclusive choice stays on the page.
Use OptionList when the options live in a popover or sheet.
Do not put Checkbox inside Field.Root.
Do not wire Checkbox and OptionList to the same value.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label. Clicking the text toggles the input.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state. Defined means controlled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fires after the checked state changes.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid and sets aria-invalid.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the wrapping label.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Text-only label with optional named dismiss. Overflow +N is Chip.Overflow.
whenToUse: Text-only token with optional named dismiss. Overflow +N is ChipOverflow.
whenNotToUse: +N is not a button and is not in the tab order. Do not use Chip as a filter control that owns selection.

components.name: DensityProvider
components.description: Sets data-density for spacing-only compact, comfortable, or spacious.
whenToUse: Sets data-density for spacing-only compact, comfortable, or spacious.
whenNotToUse: Does not change type size or color. Nested providers override.

components.name: Description
components.description: Supporting text below a control. Required id. Sibling, not a Field part. Author wires aria-describedby.
whenToUse: Supporting hint below a control. Required id. Sibling, not a Field part. Author wires aria-describedby.
whenNotToUse: Use ErrorMessage for validation text. Do not nest Description inside Field.Root.

props.name: id
props.description: Id the author lists in aria-describedby on the control or Field.Root.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Controlled native modal dialog. Stays centered. No sheet morph.
whenToUse: Centered native modal dialog. Controlled open. Escape and backdrop dismiss are opt-out.
Use Dialog for a modal confirm that stays on screen.
whenNotToUse: Use BottomSheet for a mobile sheet. No sheet morph.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Dismiss requests. Staying open keeps the dialog open.

components.name: Dialog.Body
components.description: Scrollable body.
whenToUse: Scrollable dialog body.

components.name: Dialog.Close
components.description: Ghost Button.Root that requests close-button dismiss.
whenToUse: Close control that requests dismiss.

components.name: Dialog.Description
components.description: Supporting text. Wires aria-describedby on the dialog.
whenToUse: Supporting text. Wires aria-describedby on the dialog.

components.name: Dialog.Footer
components.description: Action row.
whenToUse: Action row for confirm and cancel.

components.name: Dialog.Header
components.description: Optional header row.
whenToUse: Title row for the dialog.

components.name: Dialog.Title
components.description: Heading. Wires aria-labelledby on the dialog.
whenToUse: Visible dialog title. Names the dialog when present.

components.name: ErrorMessage
components.description: Validation text below a control. Required id. No alert role. invalid lives on the control.
whenToUse: Validation text below a control. Required id. No alert role. invalid lives on the control.
whenNotToUse: Use Description for hints. Do not nest ErrorMessage inside Field.Root.

props.name: id
props.description: Id the author lists in aria-describedby on the control or Field.Root.

components.name: Field.Affix
components.description: Order-only text adornment. Not clickable. No side prop.
whenToUse: Order-only text adornment inside Field.Root. Not clickable. No side prop.
whenNotToUse: Not a free-floating atom. Product trees import Field.Affix, not a raw Affix.

props.name: children
props.description: Affix content. Strings render as text.

components.name: Field.ChipInput
components.description: Controlled chips plus input inside Field.Root. Commit does not mutate chips. maxRows uses model B.
whenToUse: Controlled chips plus input inside Field.Root. Parent onCommit decides. The field never appends chips.
whenNotToUse: Do not use as a standalone control outside Field.Root. Built-in clear and paste-split are not shipped.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Fires on a commit key with a trimmed non-empty value. Does not append chips.

props.name: onChipRemove
props.description: Dismiss click or Backspace on an empty input.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Caps visual rows of chips plus input. Newest chips fold into +N. The last visible chip ellipsizes to soak leftover width before +N.

props.name: removeOnBackspace
props.description: Backspace on an empty input removes the last chip.

components.name: Field.Icon
components.description: Order-only icon. Decorative unless interactive. No side prop.
whenToUse: Order-only icon inside Field.Root. Decorative unless interactive. No side prop.
whenNotToUse: Not a free-floating atom. Do not treat Field.Icon as a public Icon export.

props.name: interactive
props.description: When false, the wrapper is aria-hidden.

components.name: Field.Root
components.description: Field chrome only. No value. Children render in source order.
whenToUse: Field chrome only. No value. Children render in source order. Label is a sibling.
whenNotToUse: Field shell is not a button. Do not put role=button on Field.Root that also hosts TextInput.
Do not nest Checkbox or Radio inside Field.Root.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and marks the shell.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the shell invalid and sets aria-invalid on the input.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Ids of Description and ErrorMessage. Put this on Root. TextInput overwrites input-level aria.

props.name: ref
props.description: Shell element. Use as a Popover anchorRef.

props.name: children
props.description: TextInput or ChipInput plus optional Icon and Affix. Order is leading/trailing.

slots.name: children
slots.description: One input plus optional Icon and Affix. Order is leading or trailing.

components.name: Field.TextInput
components.description: Controlled text-ish input inside Field.Root.
whenToUse: Controlled text-ish input inside Field.Root.
whenNotToUse: Do not set aria-describedby on Field.TextInput. Put it on Field.Root.

components.name: Label
components.description: Visible name for a control. Sibling, not a Field part. Pass htmlFor the control id.
whenToUse: Visible name for a control. Sibling, not a Field part. htmlFor must match the control id.
whenNotToUse: A role=radiogroup is not labelable. Caption RadioGroup with Text and aria-labelledby.
Do not nest Label inside Field.Root.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Id of the labelled control. Must match Field.Root id when captioning a Field.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text. A required mark is authored here when needed.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the native label.

components.name: Option
components.description: String-only option. Also available as OptionList.Option.
whenToUse: String-only option. Also available as OptionList.Option.
whenNotToUse: Text children only. Do not nest interactive controls inside Option.

components.name: OptionList
components.description: Overlay listbox. Single or multiple. Use Radio or Checkbox for a permanent choice on the page.
whenToUse: Overlay listbox. Keep it inside a Popover or BottomSheet.
A combobox can pass id, activeValue, onActiveChange, and tabIndex={-1} so the input owns focus.
whenNotToUse: Use Radio when one choice stays on the page.
Use Checkbox when several independent choices stay on the page.
Do not wire OptionList and Radio or Checkbox to the same value.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Single fires onChange(string). Multiple fires onChange(string[]).

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value, or values when selectionMode is multiple.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Selection change. Single passes a string. Multiple passes the next array.

props.name: id
props.description: Listbox id. Auto-generated when omitted. Option ids derive from it.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Listbox tabIndex. Pass -1 when a combobox input owns focus.

props.name: activeValue
props.description: Controlled highlighted value. Omit to keep highlight inside the list.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when keyboard or pointer moves the highlight.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name when no visible label is present.

components.name: OptionList.Option
components.description: String-only option. Same as the top-level Option export.
whenToUse: String-only option. Same as the top-level Option export.
whenNotToUse: Text children only.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Surface chrome. Spread getPopoverProps for wire.
whenToUse: Surface chrome for a non-modal popover. Spread getPopoverProps from usePopover or useCombobox.
whenNotToUse: There is no Popover.Trigger or Popover.Content.
Do not spread getTriggerProps and also pass anchorRef.

props.name: style
props.description: Style for the surface. Anchor position comes from getPopoverProps.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no visible caption exists.

components.name: Radio
components.description: One option in a RadioGroup. No checked, name, or invalid. Children are the visible label.
whenToUse: One option in a RadioGroup. Children are the visible label. No checked, name, or invalid.
whenNotToUse: A radio outside a group throws. Use OptionList when the options live in an overlay.

props.name: value
props.description: Option value. The group owns selection.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this option. The group disabled flag also applies.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the wrapping label.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: Exclusive choice. Requires aria-label or aria-labelledby. Owns value, name, disabled, and invalid.
whenToUse: Exclusive choice that stays on the page. Requires aria-label or aria-labelledby.
Caption with Text and aria-labelledby. Do not point Label htmlFor at the group.
whenNotToUse: Use OptionList when the options live in a popover or sheet.
Wiring Radio and OptionList to the same value is a QA fail.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no visible caption exists. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the visible caption. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. null is controlled with nothing selected. Omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the next selected value.

props.name: name
props.description: Shared native name. Generated when omitted.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Flex layout. Gap comes from the stack.gap contract token.
whenToUse: Flex layout between fields or sections. Gap comes from the stack.gap contract token.
whenNotToUse: Do not wrap a label/control pair in Stack. Use .labelled-field for that gap.

components.name: Switch
components.description: On or off. Track and thumb. Children are the visible label. No check glyph.
whenToUse: On or off. Track and thumb. Children are the visible label. No check glyph.
whenNotToUse: Use Checkbox for an independent item in a list of choices. Do not put Switch inside Field.Root.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label. Clicking the text toggles the switch.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled on state. Defined means controlled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fires after the on state changes.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid and sets aria-invalid.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the wrapping label.

components.name: Text
components.description: Text styled through the text contract tokens.
whenToUse: Text styled through the text contract tokens. Use it to caption a RadioGroup.
whenNotToUse: Do not use Text as a label for a labelable control. Use Label with htmlFor.

components.name: ThemeProvider
components.description: Sets data-appearance from system, light, or dark. Nested providers override.
whenToUse: Sets data-appearance from system, light, or dark. Nested providers override.
whenNotToUse: Never writes data-appearance=system. The resolved value is light or dark.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Resolved to light or dark before writing data-appearance. Never writes system.

props.name: overrides
props.description: Closed allowlist of raw, semantic, and component token paths. Values are typed; unknown keys and raw CSS are rejected.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Tip chrome. Spread getTooltipProps for wire.
whenToUse: Tip chrome. Spread getTooltipProps. Default is text-only role=tooltip.
whenNotToUse: There is no Tooltip.Trigger or Tooltip.Content.
Do not set interactive on Tooltip. Pass interactive to useTooltip.

props.name: children
props.description: Tooltip text, or short prose plus links when interactive.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the tip surface.

props.name: style
props.description: Style for the tip surface. Anchor position comes from getTooltipProps.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no visible caption exists. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby when interactive.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the visible caption. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby when interactive.

components.name: useChipField
components.description: Optional state helper. Field.ChipInput stays fully controlled without it.
whenToUse: Optional state helper. Holds chips and input, then spreads onto Field.ChipInput.
whenNotToUse: Field.ChipInput stays fully controlled without it.

props.name: transform
props.description: Normalize a commit. Null rejects. Default trims and rejects empty.

components.name: useCombobox
components.description: Headless combobox state. Spread getters onto Field, Button, Popover, BottomSheet, and OptionList. No Combobox chrome.
whenToUse: Headless combobox state. Spread getters onto Field, Button, Popover, BottomSheet, and OptionList.
presentation auto uses useSheetPresentation.
whenNotToUse: No Combobox chrome. Do not export Combobox.Root, Combobox.Trigger, or Combobox.Icon.
Do not dual-wire aria or open outside the hook while also using it.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Single uses TextInput. Multiple uses ChipInput.

props.name: options
props.description: Sync options. Ignored when loadOptions is set.

props.name: loadOptions
props.description: Async options. Stale responses are discarded.

props.name: allowCreate
props.description: Show a create row when the query has no case-insensitive label match.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Null for empty single. Array for multiple.

components.name: usePopover
components.description: One open machine. Spread getTriggerProps onto the trigger and getPopoverProps onto Popover.
whenToUse: Open machine for Popover. Spread getTriggerProps on the trigger and getPopoverProps on Popover.
whenNotToUse: Do not spread getTriggerProps and also pass anchorRef.
Combobox uses getAnchorProps on Field.Root instead of this trigger.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires on toggle or dismiss. Leaving open unchanged is a veto.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: Sets CSS anchor-name on this element and excludes it from outside press.

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description: Focus this element when the popover opens.

props.name: restoreFocusRef
props.description: Return focus here when the popover closes.

props.name: enabled
props.description: False skips toggle, dismiss, and focus moves.

props.name: id
props.description: Popover id. Default is a generated id.

components.name: useSheetPresentation
components.description: Coarse pointer or narrow width selects sheet. SSR and first paint are popover. isSheet mirrors presentation.
whenToUse: Chooses sheet when the pointer is coarse or the viewport is narrower than 640px. Otherwise popover.
whenNotToUse: isSheet mirrors presentation === "sheet". It is not isTouch. First paint is popover.

props.name: narrowWidth
props.description: Viewport width that starts the narrow media query. Media is max-width: n - 1.

props.name: coarseQuery
props.description: matchMedia query treated as coarse pointer.

props.name: forced
props.description: Skip media when popover or sheet. auto uses coarse OR narrow.

components.name: useTooltip
components.description: One open machine. Spread getTriggerProps onto the trigger and getTooltipProps onto Tooltip. Interactive is a non-modal tip dialog.
whenToUse: Open machine for Tooltip. Spread getTriggerProps on the trigger and getTooltipProps on Tooltip.
Pass interactive: true for a non-modal tip dialog with links. Never role=tooltip in that mode.
whenNotToUse: Set tooltip={false} on Button.Root when this hook owns the machine.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Use the non-modal tip dialog. Links only. Never role=tooltip.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires after a commit. Leaving open unchanged is a veto.

props.name: showDelay
props.description: Hover show delay in milliseconds. Focus shows at once.

props.name: enabled
props.description: False resets intent and commits close.

props.name: id
props.description: Tooltip id. Default is a generated id.

patterns.name: Choice group
patterns.description: On-page RadioGroup or Checkbox versus overlay OptionList. Never bind both to one value.
whenToUse: Use RadioGroup when one exclusive choice stays on the page.
Use Checkbox when several independent choices stay on the page.
Use OptionList when the choices live in a Popover or BottomSheet.
whenNotToUse: Do not wire OptionList and Radio or Checkbox to the same value.
Do not put Checkbox or Radio inside Field.Root.

fills.name: captionId
fills.description: Id of the visible Text caption. RadioGroup is not labelable via htmlFor.

fills.name: value
fills.description: Selected radio value, or null when nothing is selected.

fills.name: radios
fills.description: Radio children. Swap this tree for Checkbox siblings or an overlay OptionList.

patterns.name: Combobox popover
patterns.description: Desktop combobox recipe. Closed control is a Field. List lives in Popover.
whenToUse: Search-select on a wide pointer viewport.
Spread getAnchorProps onto Field.Root. Do not also spread usePopover getTriggerProps.
whenNotToUse: Use combobox-sheet when the closed control is a Button and the list is a BottomSheet.
Do not export Combobox.* chrome. This is a recipe, not a namespace.

fills.name: inputId
fills.description: Id shared by Label htmlFor and the combobox input.

fills.name: label
fills.description: Visible field caption.

fills.name: leadingIcon
fills.description: Decorative or search icon before the input.

fills.name: trailingIcon
fills.description: Decorative chevron after the input.

fills.name: options
fills.description: Option or OptionList.Option children for the current query.

patterns.name: Combobox sheet
patterns.description: Touch combobox recipe. Closed control is Button.Root. Search Field lives inside BottomSheet.
whenToUse: Search-select on a coarse pointer or a narrow viewport.
Spread getTriggerProps onto Button.Root. Put the search Field inside the sheet.
whenNotToUse: Use combobox-popover when the closed control is a Field anchored to a Popover.
Do not pretend Field.Root is the touch trigger.

fills.name: triggerLabel
fills.description: Closed-control label on Button.Root.

fills.name: inputId
fills.description: Id shared by the in-sheet Label and Field.Root.

fills.name: label
fills.description: Visible search caption inside the sheet.

fills.name: leadingIcon
fills.description: Decorative search icon.

fills.name: options
fills.description: Option or OptionList.Option children for the current query.

patterns.name: Confirm dialog
patterns.description: Centered Dialog with title, body, and footer actions. Stays a dialog. No sheet morph.
whenToUse: Ask the user to confirm or cancel before a commit.
For a destructive commit, label the confirm action clearly and keep the dialog centered.
whenNotToUse: Use BottomSheet when the task is a mobile sheet, not a confirm.
Do not morph this dialog into a sheet.

fills.name: open
fills.description: Controlled open flag.

fills.name: title
fills.description: Dialog.Title copy.

fills.name: body
fills.description: Explanation in Dialog.Body.

fills.name: cancelLabel
fills.description: Ghost footer action that dismisses.

fills.name: confirmLabel
fills.description: Primary footer action that commits. Name the destructive verb when needed.

patterns.name: Labelled field
patterns.description: Label + Field.Root + optional Description and ErrorMessage as siblings.
whenToUse: Caption a text or chip field. Wrap the stack in one .labelled-field.
Put aria-describedby on Field.Root, not on the input.
whenNotToUse: Do not nest Label inside Field.Root. Label is a sibling.
Do not wrap the label/control stack in Stack. stack.gap is the gap between fields.

fills.name: fieldId
fills.description: Shared id for Label htmlFor and Field.Root.

fills.name: label
fills.description: Visible caption. Author a required mark here when needed.

fills.name: invalid
fills.description: When true, Field.Root marks the input invalid.

fills.name: describedBy
fills.description: Space-separated hint and error ids listed on Field.Root.

fills.name: value
fills.description: Controlled input value.

fills.name: hintId
fills.description: Description id included in aria-describedby.

fills.name: hint
fills.description: Supporting hint copy.

fills.name: errorId
fills.description: ErrorMessage id included in aria-describedby when invalid.

fills.name: error
fills.description: Validation copy. Render ErrorMessage only when invalid.
